sources.entry: Honer AI - Android assistant for AI conversations, writing, translation, and web search with sources, with Russian and English interfaces. #free

summary.name: Honer AI
summary.one_liner: An Android AI chat assistant by HONER that offers conversations, writing help, translation, and web search with source links, distributed as a compiled APK from a GitHub Pages page.
use_cases: Chatting with an AI assistant on an Android phone
Getting web search answers with source links
Analyzing attached photos or documents with AI
Translating text or drafting writing with AI
Using voice input and read-aloud replies on Android
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Honer AI version 10.57.0 for Android, package com.honerai.app, requiring Android 7.0 or later, with Russian and English interfaces. Features named include AI chat, web search with source links, analysis of attached photos and documents, voice input and read-aloud replies via Android speech services, and conversation history with search, pinning, archiving and branching. AI responses and web search require internet access and cloud processing. The page links to the original APK, a SHA-256 checksum, privacy policy and terms. The repository distributes compiled releases only; the application is proprietary and its source code is not published there.
notable: Web search answers include source links
Verifiable APK with published SHA-256 checksum
caveats: Stable APK is free to download, but the page does not promise unlimited or permanently free cloud service
Requires internet; AI responses and web search depend on cloud processing
Android 7.0 or later only; proprietary app with no source code published
